purpose: Define Node Content API as the extensible typed content layer for node graph content, initially including comment and example, without allowing node renderers to invent hidden semantic types.

topics.name: Node Content API
topics.purpose: Define Node Content API as the extensible typed content layer for node graph content, initially including comment and example, without allowing node renderers to invent hidden semantic types.

semantics.engine_rule: Node graph engine owns nodes, ports and edges; Node Content API owns registered node-content types and bindings.
semantics.type_rule: Each content type has explicit identity and schema.
semantics.semantic_rule: Content type meaning is explicit; renderer/UI does not infer hidden semantics from arbitrary blobs.
semantics.extension_rule: New content types register through the API with schema/metadata.
semantics.projection_rule: Rendering/editing a content type is projection; canonical content remains typed source data.
semantics.authority_rule: Node content cannot grant runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Expose components reuse canonical semantics and remain non-privileged projection/composition surfaces.

hard_gates.condition: renderer invents unregistered semantic content type
opaque node blob requires hidden heuristic interpretation
content schema omitted for machine-significant structured content
comment/example renderer output treated as canonical source

references.purpose: Node Content API extends the node graph content surface.
Structured node content uses explicit schema.
